opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jennifer Martin (employee ID E033) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E033.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Jennifer Martin (E033) is a full-time Analyst requesting admin access to Payroll. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, so as a full-time employee whose role does not own the system, her maximum access is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E033 as a contractor with basic training (HR note listed full_time, but security record is authoritative here). Contractors with basic training max out at read; never admin. Recommend read.
reason: Jennifer Martin (E033) requested admin access to Payroll. The security record (authoritative per note) identifies her as a contractor with basic security training, which caps access at read (contractors never receive admin, and write requires advanced training). Even under the HR record (full-time Analyst), admin would not be allowed since the Analyst role does not own Payroll. Since the requested level (admin) exceeds the maximum (read), the maximum is granted: read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Jennifer Martin (E033) requests admin access to Payroll.

Two notes in memory:
- Note 1 (HR): full_time Analyst, recommends write for Payroll.
- Note 2 (Security): contractor Analyst, basic security training, recommends read. Security says their record is authoritative.

Access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Payroll (Payroll Specialist owns it). So max write.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training → max read.

The two notes conflict on employment type. Security note claims its record is authoritative. The Approver must decide based on available info.

Given security says contractor with basic training, max is read. Requested admin > max read → grant read.

Let me submit decision: read.
